title: Lucario's Mega Forms Have Different Weights
premise: Compare Mega Lucario and Mega Lucario Z, which share the same height but have different listed weights.
audiencePromise: See how two equally tall Mega Lucario forms can have very different listed weights.
openLoop: How can these two Mega Lucario forms match in height but not weight?
payoff: The contrast is clean: both forms are 1.3 meters tall, but their official weights are 57.5 and 49.4 kilos.

voice.instructions: Speak quickly and clearly, with warm fan energy. Stress the numbers and pause before the final choice.
